tiers._groups_note: Close or getting closer: within very_close votes or %, or getting closer (see swing). Somewhat close: within watch votes or %.
tiers._swing_note: Swing = biggest change in a contest's margin over its last swing_updates updates (at least swing_min votes). Getting closer = within 1 swing of the recount line, or down at each of the last 2 updates and within swing_narrowing swings.

_exclude_contests_note: Contests that cross county lines. Match is a case-insensitive substring of the contest name. Add or remove names here.
